programme.title: Mauvaise promotion
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités au QG de la marque de chaussures Daka, où on leur offre une belle somme d'argent pour essayer les nouvelles chaussures Daka, "Tech-foot", sur iCarly..

programme.title: La promesse
programme.desc: Carly obtient un B à un devoir d'Histoire pour lequel elle pensait avoir un A. Durant sa réunion hebdomadaire avec le principal Franklin, Sam change la note sur l'ordinateur et surprend Carly avec le A qu'elle mérite.

programme.title: On passe à la télé
programme.desc: Un producteur très influent veut transposer iCarly à la télévision. Mais Carly, Sam et Freddie sont vite décontenancés par les changements que le producteur veut opérer dans l'émission...

programme.title: Un petit ami très envahissant
programme.desc: Sam se trouve un petit ami, et ces deux là sont inséparables. Mais quand leur relation se met à interférer avec iCarly, Carly et Freddie savent qu'ils doivent intervenir.

programme.title: Les videos pirates
programme.desc: Après avoir regardé un extrait d'iCarly qui montre un homme vendre des copies illégales de films, deux détectives décident de se servir de Carly et Spencer pour leur enquête.

programme.title: En route pour luniversité
programme.desc: Carly apprend que son émission lui ouvre les portes d'une scolarité dans une école privée très cotée. Carly doute encore, mais Sam et Freddie savent qu'ils n'ont pas envie de la voir partir...

programme.title: Adversaires
programme.desc: Freddie part faire de l'escrime avec Spencer. Il s'en sort bien, mais les choses se compliquent lorsque Spencer se retrouve impliqué dans un match avec l'incroyable Doug Toder.

programme.title: Je gagne un rencard
programme.desc: Gibby est trop timide pour demander à la fille qui lui plait de sortir avec lui, le groupe décide alors d'organiser une tranche "je gagne un rendez-vous" sur leur émission.

programme.title: Ma prof est folle
programme.desc: Madame Ackerman, le professeur du groupe, est en pleine rupture avec son petit-ami, ce qui la rend aigrie avec ses étudiants. Une visite de Spencer pour arranger les choses se transforme en rendez-vous.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: ICarly va au Japon
programme.desc: Carly, Sam, Spencer et Freddie se rendent au Japon pour les iWeb Awards. Après un vol qui a failli mal tourné, nos quatre amis se retrouvent dans un hôtel de Tokyo.

programme.title: Je lai vu la première
programme.desc: Carly et Sam s'intéressent au même garçon, mais elles se jurent qu'il ne sèmera pas la zizanie entre elles. Malheureusement, les choses ne se déroulent pas si facilement et elles finissent par entrer en compétition.

programme.title: Pak-Rat
programme.desc: Spencer devient accro à un jeu-vidéo et Carly doit intervenir. De son côté, Sam fait croire à Freddie qu'il est maudit pour avoir refusé de transmettre une lettre chaîne.

programme.title: Pour une poignée de dollars
programme.desc: Sam se sent insultée quand Freddie l'accuse de ne pas rembourser l'argent qu'elle emprunte. Du coup elle va tout faire pour effacer ses dettes. Voyant le travail qu'elle fournit, Sam et Carly décident de l'aider secrètement.

programme.title: Jembête Lewbert
programme.desc: Alors qu'une histoire d'amour est sur le point de naître entre Lewbert et Mme Benson, la bande décide de leur mettre des bâtons dans les roues.

programme.title: Metamorphosis
programme.desc: Trois jeunes voyagent à travers la campagne hongroise dans l'espoir d'étayer la thèse au sujet de la légendaire Comtesse Elizabeth Bathory, réputée pour s'être baignée dans le sang au XVIIème siècle. Mais ils se perdent sur le retour, jusqu'à ce qu'une étrange jeune femme leur propose de les conduire au château Bathory.

programme.title: Showtime
programme.desc: Pendant la nuit de la plus grande finale sportive de l'année, deux filles travaillant dans une station-service vivent d'étranges incidents. S'agit-il simplement de farces mises en scène ou d'une intention plus agressive ?

programme.title: Cercle Infernal
programme.desc: La vie de deux sœurs change radicalement, depuis qu'elles ont été hypnotisées par un disque vinyle mystique des années 1970.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln Contre Les Zombies
programme.desc: Durant la guerre civile, Abraham Lincoln apprend qu'une menace pèse sur l'avenir des États-Unis. Une armée de morts-vivants sudistes erre sur la surface du continent. En passant derrière les lignes ennemies, le Président se donne pour mission de détruire les zombies...

programme.title: Magie de noël
programme.desc: Après un accident de voiture, une femme se réveille à Central Park avec un ange, qui lui donne une chance de gagner l'entrée au paradis.Le film est une histoire de découverte et le véritable esprit de Noël.

programme.title: Shelby
programme.desc: Jake Parker, un enfant magicien de dix ans, a toujours rêvé d'avoir un chien pour Noël. Le miracle arrive lorsque Shelby, un beagle orphelin, s'échappe du chenil et vient se réfugier chez lui.

programme.title: L'aventure Magique de Noël
programme.desc: La veille de Noël, la famille Nolan se retrouve transportée au Pôle Nord, où le Père Noël leur annonce qu'il a besoin de leur aide pour sauver Noël!

programme.title: If You Believe
programme.desc: Une rédactrice en chef blasée a presque abandonné sa quête du bonheur, jusqu'à ce qu'elle se cogne la tête et reçoive la visite de son soi plus jeune (Hayden Panettiere). À présent, la joyeuse et insouciante fille de sept ans aide Susan, une adulte, à redécouvrir son enfant intérieur.

programme.desc: No information

programme.title: Personne ne s'aimera jamais comme on s'aime
programme.desc: Pauline et Noham s'aiment à la folie. Quand la mère de Pauline lui annonce qu'elles déménagent à Paris, Pauline, incapable de se séparer de Noham, décide de rester vivre dans sa ville natale. Seulement voilà, Pauline n'a que dix ans…

programme.title: Le bûcheron des mots
programme.desc: Dans un pays où les habitants se nourrissent, au sens propre, de lettres et de mots cueillis dans les arbres, la lecture est vitale s'ils ne veulent pas mourir... d'ennui. Mais certains livres sont interdits à cause de leur contenu émotionnel et des transformations physiques qu'ils provoquent. Nadal, un bûcheron des mots, fait une rencontre qui change définitivement sa vie...

programme.title: Circuit marine
programme.desc: Un bateau en haute mer, les marins pêchent, mangent, boivent...et chantent. Le chat regarde le perroquet, le perroquet regarde le joli poisson dans son bocal, le chat regarde le poisson... Qui mangera qui ?

programme.title: La grande migration
programme.desc: Les aventures humoristiques d'un oiseau migrateur qui perd ses congénères dans les nuages...

programme.title: Una furtiva lagrima
programme.desc: Ultime voyage d'un poisson qui chante son propre requiem, depuis la vente à la poissonnerie jusque dans la poêle à frire.

programme.title: Fatigués d'être beaux
programme.desc: Deux cow-boys partent à la recherche d'une balle qu'ils ont tirée dans le désert.

programme.title: Pépé le morse
programme.desc: Sur la plage sombre et venteuse, Mémé prie, Maman hurle, les frangines s'en foutent, Lucas est seul. Pépé était bizarre comme type, maintenant il est mort.

programme.title: Les chiens isolés
programme.desc: Sur une plateforme pétrolière, une histoire d'amitié entre deux ouvriers se voit compromise par la démence paranoïaque de l'un deux.

programme.title: Shudo
programme.desc: Deux samurais s'affrontent sur un champ de bataille ravagé par la guerre. Absorbés par leur orgueil, ils se lancent dans un duel alimenté par leur ressentiment.

programme.title: Le portefeuille
programme.desc: Un jour, un homme trouve un portefeuille par terre. Ou bien, ne l'a-t-il pas vu ? Il décide de le rendre à son propriétaire et aussi de le garder pour lui.

programme.title: L'évasion
programme.desc: Un homme est en prison. Son compagnon de cellule est torturé jusqu'à la mort. Quand ses geôliers viennent le chercher à son tour, il parvient à s'enfuir dans l'enceinte du bâtiment. Geste désespéré car il s'agit d'un vrai labyrinthe. Il échappe pourtant à ses poursuivants jusqu'au toit de l'immeuble. Du haut des miradors, un militaire le tient en joue. Là il exprime devant eux toute la mesure de sa liberté.

programme.title: Nimbus Machina
programme.desc: Le désert, le vent, un rail. Une étrange machine passe et crache de gigantesques nuages de vapeur et de suie.

programme.title: Les voiles du partage
programme.desc: Etienne Bernard part en exil dans les terres du Nord pour y chercher l'aventure. A peine arrivé, il est plongé directement dans l'ambiance : la ville est aux mains d'une mafia locale qui fait du trafic de chars à voile...

programme.title: Betty's blues
programme.desc: Un jeune guitariste tente sa chance dans un vieux bar de blues de Louisiane. Il évoque la légende de Blind Boogie Jones, dans la Nouvelle Orléans des années 1920, une histoire d'amour et de vengeance...

programme.title: Ephémères
programme.desc: Sur le mur d'une vieille maison, un éphémère cherche sa place parmi les photos de famille.

programme.title: Petit bonhomme
programme.desc: Henri a neuf ans pas tout à fait et demi. Le temps d'un après-midi à la piscine, il décide de suivre les conseils de son père pour séduire la petite Rachel dont il est fou amoureux.

programme.title: Billy the Killy
programme.desc: Un documentaire sur la façon dont Martin Gretschmann compose un chef-d'œuvre de musique binaire. Une boite à rythme lance l'installation tandis qu'une enclume la stoppe net. Entre les deux, une succession d'images dont une poupée qui adresse un clin d'œil à Kill Bill…

programme.title: Train de vie
programme.desc: Dans une gare perdue en pleine cambrousse, le retard d'un train va amener trois personnages à sortir de leur isolement quotidien.

programme.title: T'étais où quand Michaël Jackson est mort ?
programme.desc: Paris, quelques jours après la mort du roi de la pop, quelques jours avant noël, une rencontre les bouscule, Elle et Lui, à l'arrière d'un taxi. Ils roulent au milieu des lumières de la ville, le temps d'un désir.

programme.title: La révolution des crabes
programme.desc: Les crabes de l'estuaire de la Gironde ont un sérieux handicap : ils ne peuvent pas changer de direction et sont condamnés à marcher toute leur vie suivant la même ligne droite. Comment vivent-ils ce tragique destin ?

programme.title: Des millions de larmes
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'une rencontre dans un café-restaurant désert le long d'une route. Un homme d'une soixantaine d'années qui attend là. Une jeune femme fait son entrée, un sac sur le dos, sa vie dedans et la mine passablement fatiguée. Il lui propose de l'avancer. Elle accepte.

programme.title: Bande démo
programme.desc: Samir est un comédien Belge, débrouillard, beau parleur, mais habitué aux complications à répétition. Lorsqu'il parvient à décrocher ce rendez-vous avec un agent important, les choses se compliquent lorsque ce dernier lui demande d'apporter sa bande démo…

programme.title: Bang Bang !
programme.desc: Bang ! Bang ! C'est l'ouverture de la chasse. Et aussi l'anniversaire d'Éda : vingt-cinq ans. Pour fêter ça, son père lui offre un appartement qui vient d'être saisi. Happy Birthday ! Éda fuit. Elle roule vite, trop vite. Quand un chien rose surgit dans ses phares, c'est l'accident. Effrayée par l'étrange animal, elle s'engouffre dans la forêt où son père mène la chasse…

programme.title: Eclipse
programme.desc: Sur une planète éloignée, deux scientifiques venus analyser le terrain pour ses particularités magnétiques sont confrontés à un phénomène extraordinaire lié à une éclipse de lune.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Robin se fait larguer par sa copine, Annie, parce qu'il n'arrive pas à lui exprimer ses sentiments. Aidé de son chien, il va tout faire pour la récupérer.

programme.title: Mortal break-up inferno
programme.desc: La traque infernale d'un jeune homme par sa copine qui n'a pas digéré leur rupture.

programme.title: Grounded
programme.desc: Un jeune soldat sans expérience est envoyé à un poste de surveillance, au beau milieu d'un désert.

programme.title: La semaine des 4 jeudis
programme.desc: Marc a rencontré une fille qui lui a tapé dans l'oeil. Leur histoire va être d'autant plus compliquée que la semaine des quatre jeudis commence aujourd'hui.

programme.title: Fugazi
programme.desc: 2039 : depuis plus de 3 ans, Adèle travaille pour Orbit Defence, une station spatiale chargée du pilotage de drones sur la planète Terre. Aujourd'hui, tenant entre ses mains des joysticks, il ne lui reste plus qu'une mission de routine à accomplir avant de rejoindre enfin sa famille.

programme.title: A l'ombre du voile
programme.desc: Deux femmes musulmanes, une mère et sa fille, se rendent à une manifestation contre l'interdiction du voile à l'école. De retour à la maison, la mère invite sa fille à abandonner ce voile à travers une danse désespérée et troublante.

programme.title: Le pont
programme.desc: Un homme et son fils vivent au sommet d'un pic escarpé, totalement coupés du monde extérieur : le père a veillé à tenir son fils éloigné des réalités de l'humanité. Mais une nuit, l'enfant aperçoit, en bas de la falaise, une ville dont les lumières brillent.

programme.title: Paix sur la terre
programme.desc: La nuit tombe quelque part sur la terre. Ca et là, des ovoïdes traversent le ciel et s'abattent sur le sol. Peu après, on retrouve des sièges vides et des cannes à pêche plantées dans l'herbe... Tout devient extrêmement calme.

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: April Rain
programme.desc: Lorsque des complots terroristes visent à attaquer les États-Unis de l'intérieur, une unité spéciale d'enquête quasi-militaire doit identifier, infiltrer et neutraliser la menace...

programme.title: Maximum Conviction
programme.desc: Deux anciens agents des opérations secrètes doivent transférer deux femmes condamnées dans une prison. En chemin, ils sont attaqués par des inconnus.

programme.title: Indian ninja
programme.desc: An ex-Interpol officer, Don The Dragon Wilson, now DEA Agent tracks the man who killed his former partner to India, where he finds himself on a one-man mission to clean up the criminal underworld. There he is forced to use his Interpol police training to deal with the most ancient customs in the underbelly of foreign culture.

programme.title: L'Ascension D'un Homme De Main
programme.desc: L'histoire vraie de Carlton Leach jeune hooligan Anglais qui intègre un des gangs les plus connus du pays à la fin des années 80. Il grimpe alors les échelons au point de devenir le criminel le plus respecté mais aussi détesté. Il devra faire face à ses propres démons lors de cette montée en puissance vers le grand banditisme et tout faire pour éviter la prison.

programme.title: Thick and Thin
programme.desc: Le capitaine mercenaire « Hawk » est de retour à Acion pour sauver un otage. Mais lui et son équipe sont trahis. Rien ne se passe comme prévu...

programme.title: A deadly vision
programme.desc: Une serveuse qui a des visions psychiques de meurtres avant qu'elles ne se produisent est sollicitée par un détective de police pour l'aider à retrouver un tueur en série.

programme.title: Pets To The Rescue
programme.desc: Lorsque un frère et une sœur sont enlevés après avoir trouvé un camion d'or volé, ce sont leurs animaux de compagnie qui doivent prendre les choses en main pour les sauver !

programme.title: Alice Through The Looking Glass
programme.desc: Dans ce conte classique, Alice tombe à travers un miroir et arrive dans un endroit merveilleux appelé le Pays des Merveilles ! Le voyage d'Alice à travers les huit carrés fous du Pays des Merveilles est présenté à l'écran dans un film d'animation de haute qualité, divertissant pour vos enfants et votre famille. En chemin, Alice rencontre des amis comme Bonnet blanc, et des ennemis tels que le méchant Jaseroque et le Bandersnatch !

programme.title: Dangerous Intentions
programme.desc: Depuis des années, Beth Williamson supporte le comportement extrêmement violent de son mari Tim. Elle cache la terrible réalité à sa famille ainsi qu'à ses amis, mais surtout à sa fille Laurie. Un jour, elle décide de prendre sa vie en main et retourne chez sa mère. Emprisonné puis relâché, Tim a juré de se venger. Entre temps Beth rencontre Kaye, elle aussi victime de violence conjugale. Les deux amies prennent une maison ensemble en espérant que la vie va enfin commencer pour elles et leurs enfants...

programme.title: Braquage à New York
programme.desc: Henry, un percepteur de péage, est injustement emprisonné après avoir aidé sans le savoir des amis à commettre un vol de banque. En prison, il se lie d'amitié avec Max, un escroc charmant. Après avoir purgé sa peine, Henry découvre un vieux tunnel reliant la banque à un théâtre.

programme.title: Troupe d'élite
programme.desc: Inspiré des vrais faits de la Batalhão de Operações Policiais Especiais (BOPE), le Bataillon des opérations spéciales de la police militaire de Rio de Janeiro.

programme.title: Usurpation
programme.desc: Katie déménage en ville avec sa jeune fille pour démarrer une nouvelle vie. Elle devient rapidement amie avec un autre couple qui commence à se poser des questions après avoir observé son étrange comportement.

programme.title: The Blair Witch Project
programme.desc: The Blair Witch Project suit un trio de cinéastes au cours de ce qui aurait dû être une simple balade en forêt, mais qui devient rapidement une excursion dans une terreur pétrifiante.

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: Un procureur voit sa vie basculer lorsqu'il est impliqué dans un délit de fuite et qu'un autre homme est arrêté pour son crime et accusé de meurtre.

programme.title: La Maison aux esprits
programme.desc: Adapté du roman d'Isabel Allende, La Maison aux esprits est une saga familiale d'un romantisme envoûtant s'étendant sur trois générations de la famille Trueba. Au cœur de l'histoire, il y a la relation orageuse et passionnée entre Clara, une jeune femme dotée d'un don surnaturel, et son mari, l'autoritaire Esteban, qui résiste au changement, qu'il soit politique ou personnel.

programme.title: Once
programme.desc: Une comédie Musiqueale moderne sur un Musiqueien des rues et une immigrante et leur semaine pleine de rebondissements à Dublin alors qu'ils écrivent, répètent et enregistrent des chansons qui racontent leur histoire d'amour.

programme.title: Paper Heart
programme.desc: Charlyne Yi se lance dans une quête pour réaliser un documentaire sur le seul sujet qu'elle ne comprend pas: l'amour. Quand elle rencontre un garçon selon son propre cœur (Michael Cera), les choses deviennent intéressantes.

programme.title: How to Be a Latin Lover
programme.desc: Eugenio Derbez (NI REPRIS, NI ÉCHANGÉ) est l'acteur principal de cette comédie furieusement drôle au casting de rêve ! Lorsque Maximo, le séducteur latin vieillissant (Derbez), se fait plaquer par la femme d'âge mûr qu'il a épousée pour son argent, il emménage chez sa sœur Sara (Salma Hayek), à qui il ne parlait plus, et Hugo, son fils de dix ans.

programme.title: Le Sorcier et le Serpent blanc
programme.desc: Un herboriste tombe amoureux d'un serpent vieux de cent ans déguisé sous les traits d'une femme. C'est alors qu'un sorcier découvre la supercherie et se bat pour sauver l'âme du vieil homme.

programme.title: Matriarch
programme.desc: Une mère enceinte et son mari se voient proposer un abri par un agriculteur et sa femme.

programme.title: Pixie
programme.desc: Pixie entreprend de venger la mort de sa mère et tente un cambriolage qui lui donnera les moyens de quitter sa petite ville et de prendre un nouveau départ. Lorsque le plan tourne terriblement mal, elle est obligée de faire équipe avec deux truands.

programme.title: La maîtresse du diable
programme.desc: Une ancienne star tente de faire un retour mais elle est menacée par un maître chanteur anonyme.

programme.title: The Toll
programme.desc: Un thriller sombre et comique sur un opérateur de péage solitaire avec un passé qui le rattrape rapidement.

programme.desc: Découvrez les interviews des stars des plus célèbres films et séries.

programme.title: L'Amour à la dérive
programme.desc: Lors d'une croisière dans les Caraïbes, Jenny est abandonnée sur une plage avec son idole du rock and roll. Délireusement amoureuse de l'idée de passer du temps seule avec lui, elle parvient à cacher le fait qu'ils sont à deux pas de leur station balnéaire.

programme.title: Ensemble à tous prix
programme.desc: Gensan et Ruby vivent en marge de la société à Los Angeles. Par une nuit fatidique, ils ratent leur chance de saisir une opportunité, ce qui déclenche une série d'événements aux conséquences désastreuses.

programme.title: About Fate
programme.desc: Alors que leurs demandes en mariage respectives échouent, Margot (Emma Roberts) et Griffin (Thomas Mann), deux grands romantiques, se retrouvent ensemble le soir du Nouvel An après une série d'événements fortuits.

programme.title: Ma super ex
programme.desc: Gauche, Matt voit sa rencontre avec Jenny (qui est en fait G-Girl) comme un cadeau. Mais quand il décide de rompre, il se retrouve confronté à une super-héroïne super rancunière.

programme.title: Le merveilleux jardin secret de Bella Brown
programme.desc: Bella, jeune femme fantasque, risque l'expulsion si elle ne remet pas son jardin en état. Elle fait alors la rencontre d'Alfie, son voisin bougon et passionné de jardinage, qui va bouleverser sa vie.

programme.title: L'homme de ma vie et moi
programme.desc: Niki anime un podcast bien connu sur les relations amoureuses. Lorsqu'un grand éditeur la contacte pour un éventuel contrat de livre, elle se retrouve en difficulté car le podcast est basé sur sa relation avec un petit ami imaginaire, Monsieur Parfait. Elle a besoin d'un remplaçant...

programme.title: Habib, la grande aventure
programme.desc: La vie d'Habib, un jeune acteur bruxellois issu de l'immigration marocaine, qui a l'opportunité de jouer le rôle principal dans un film sur la vie de François d'Assise.

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: L'une des filles du «Paradiso» sombre dans le coma après avoir prétendument fait une chute dans les escaliers. Hannah et son équipe se retrouvent confrontés à un cas épineux. En effet, entre son proxénète, avide d'argent, et les clients de l'établissement, nombreux sont les coupables potentiels…

programme.title: Code 37
programme.desc: L'une des filles du «Paradiso» sombre dans le coma après avoir prétendument fait une chute dans les escaliers. Hannah et son équipe se retrouvent confrontés à un cas épineux. En effet, entre son proxénète, avide d'argent, et les clients de l'établissement, nombreux sont les coupables potentiels…

programme.title: L'Histoire de l'Amour
programme.desc: L'histoire d'un livre perdu depuis longtemps qui réapparaît mystérieusement et relie un vieil homme à la recherche de son fils à une jeune fille cherchant un remède à la solitude de sa mère.

programme.title: Walt Avant Mickey
programme.desc: Walt Disney surmonte les obstacles de son enfance, créant Mickey Mouse et un empire légendaire.

programme.title: Ice
programme.desc: la Russie contemporaine. Nadya abandonne son rêve lorsqu'elle est hospitalisée pour une blessure.

programme.title: Opération Lidice
programme.desc: Le 27 mai 1942, à Prague, l'officier SS Reinhard Heydrich est victime d'un attentat organisé par la résistance

programme.title: Par Amour

Comme il ne lui reste que deux semaines pour en trouver un, il fait appel à Jimmy Callahan, patron d'une petite société qui se charge de fournir des entourages factices aux futurs mariés. Tout s'annonce à merveille pour la petite famille, entre matchs de volley monstres, excursions exotiques et séances de bronzette au clair de lune… Mais Mavis se rend compte que Drac est tombé sous le charme de la mystérieuse Ericka, la capitaine du navire, dont le terrible secret pourrait bien transformer les vacances idéales en un monstrueux cauchemar…

programme.title: Pete Doherty: I Was Seen As A Wreck Head!
programme.desc: Musician Pete Doherty discusses creativity, addiction and his life with Fearne Cotton. Pete explains why taking drugs was less about trying to escape and more about what he was trying to find. He confirms that 'addict' is the right word to describe his behaviour, but argues our attitude towards addiction needs to change. They catch up about the early days of The Libertines and what Pete labels as 'the chaos and risk of youth'.

programme.title: Sonia Choquette On How To Tune Into And Trust Your Intuition
programme.desc: Sonia Choquette, a spiritual teacher and intuitive guide, explains how to tune into and trust your intuition, which opens you up to a more fun, loving, and spontaneous life. Your spirit is fully equipped to take care of you. Your brain and your body might struggle, but your sixth sense – your spirit, your intuition – can take care of you no matter what.

programme.title: Poppy Jamie: There's No Such Thing As Coincidence
programme.desc: Entrepreneur and author Poppy Jamie discusses intuition, coincidence, and inner wisdom with Fearne Cotton. They explore why collective exhaustion stems from trusting logic over gut instinct, and how inexplicable moments expand our understanding of what's possible. Poppy shares her near-infertility diagnosis and how belief in magic, intuition, and the support of wise women have helped her cope.

programme.title: Perrie Edwards On The Cost Of Fame
programme.desc: A panic attack can feel like you're dying from a heart attack this is something former Little Mix member Perrie Edwards has experienced numerous times over the last few years. Perrie talks about how her anxiety feels like her adult is 'going offline', leaving the child in her crying for help.

programme.title: Michelle Keegan On Imposter Syndrome, Boundaries, And Puzzles
programme.desc: Imposter syndrome is likely to affect all of us at some point in our life Michelle Keegan still feels it every time she finishes an acting job. In this chat with Fearne, Michelle talks about her disciplined work ethic, as well as how she's learnt to cope well with the amount of rejection in her industry. They also chat about why setting boundaries – especially drawing lines between personal and professional life – is so important. Plus, they wonder why it still feels important in adulthood to seek validation from our parents.

programme.title: Monty Don: Why Doing Nothing Isn't How He Switches Off
programme.desc: What does a truly restful holiday look like? Horticulturalist Monty Don relaxes most when he knows the drill: same Greek island, same terrace for breakfast, same collapsible travel kettle packed. In this chat with Fearne, Monty explains the difference between all the globe-trotting he does for work and a proper switching-off holiday. They discuss the excitement of stepping off a plane into an entirely different culture, as well as why you won't find either of them staying up late for a social dinner.

programme.title: Miquita Oliver: "I Thought I Hated You Fearne"
programme.desc: Back in the noughties, Miquita Oliver thought Fearne Cotton was an irritatingly gorgeous, successful presenter - everything she wasn't. Fearne was jealous Miquita was part of the TV cool gang. In reality, Fearne worried she was an unsophisticated nerd, while Miquita was feeling like the fat, ugly sidekick. programme.title: I Humiliated A GB News Host On Live TV

programme.title: How The Taliban Really Works
programme.desc: Sean Langan is a British journalist and documentary filmmaker who has spent decades reporting from some of the world's most dangerous conflict zones, including Afghanistan, Iraq and Russia. He spent years covering the Taliban in his documentaries Fighting the Taliban, Meeting the Taliban and Afghan Ladies' Driving School.

programme.title: How Oligarchs Control Democracy
programme.desc: Jeffrey Winters, a political scientist at Northwestern University, explores how oligarchs turn wealth into political power. Winters challenges conventional thinking about power, arguing that oligarchs aren't just corrupt billionaires in distant countries but individuals whose vast wealth gives them influence far beyond ordinary citizens. They operate within democratic systems, not outside them.

programme.title: How America's Military Was Taken Over By White Supremacists
programme.desc: Matt Kennard discusses his book Irregular Army: How the US Military Recruited Neo-Nazis, Gang Members and Criminals. Kennard details how, as the wars in Iraq and Afghanistan dragged on, the Bush administration faced a recruitment crisis. Rather than reintroducing the draft, it loosened enlistment standards, opening the door to recruits who would previously have been barred from service.

programme.title: How AI Will Destroy Democracy
programme.desc: Daron Acemoglu, a Nobel Prize-winning economist and author of What Happened to Liberal Democracy, discusses why liberal democracy is facing one of its biggest crises in generations. Acemoglu argues that the problems facing democracies go much deeper than individual politicians. Across the UK, US and Europe, trust in political institutions has eroded as economic growth has become less widely shared, communities have weakened and the relationship between political elites and working-class voters has fractured.

programme.title: Holocaust Survivor Eviscerates The Far-Right
programme.desc: Stephen Kapos is an 88-year-old Holocaust survivor who discusses his activism, his opposition to Israel's systemic destruction of Gaza and the West Bank, and how the memory of the Holocaust is being abused by Israel and the far-right.

programme.title: Ed Sheeran's Palestine Downfall
programme.desc: Ed Sheeran dropped Macklemore from his tour over the artist's pro-Palestine platform. He played his last gig alone, after all of his supporting artists and his backing band dropped out in solidarity. Ava and Seán break down what happened and react to Sheeran's apology.

programme.title: Did A GB News Host Write A Book Full Of AI Slop?
programme.desc: Andy investigates Matthew Goodwin's new book and uncovers significant issues with its content. After Goodwin's defeat in the Gorton and Denton by-election, his release is examined closely, with Andy and Ava challenging a series of claims that don't hold up. From questionable statistics about English language use in schools to references that appear to trace back to ChatGPT, the pair expose what is at the very least a lack of academic rigour.

programme.title: Charlie's Angels S1E13
programme.desc: Charlie's Angels are summoned to try and stop an assassin intent on killing the members of an old French Underground team in "Angel Trap" on "Charlie's Angels." Fernando Lamas guest stars as Jericho, a paradoxically gentle man with a record of assassination dating back to the days of the World War II French Underground. He becomes the prime suspect when a former member of his old liberationist team is killed. From one of Jericho's ex-girlfriends, Charlie's Angels learn chat he intends to eliminate all of the members of his old French Underground team. In an attempt to capture Jericho before he can carry out his plans, Sabrina poses as the girlfriend of Kamden, the' next likely victim of the team, and Jill sets up an "accidental" meeting with Jericho. Jill soon finds it difficult to keep her mind on the job as she becomes emotionally involved with the romantic killer. She and Sabrina guess that the probable time and place of Jericho's next move will be in the city park. There, Kelly and an army of police await the inevitable. Jericho arrives in their midst, smiling confidently, carrying his pet kitten. Kate Jackson, Farrah Fawcett and Jaclyn Smith star as the Angels, Sabrina, Jill and Kelly, respectively, who work for Charlie, an unseen and very sophisticated boss who phones in their instructions. David Doyle stars as Bosley, Charlie's harried assistant.

programme.desc: Sinister forces attempt to discredit the spokesman for free Poland in "Angels on a String," on "Charlie's Angels." An international political leader is abducted and a double substituted for him at a world conference being held at a resort where Charlie's Angels are vacationing. Soon, the girls discover that the culprits plan to have their importer deliver a false, radicalized, seemingly irrational keynote address. Naturally, the press would misquote him, fatally damaging the cause. Dressed as a maid, Jill infiltrates the ranks of the phony FBI designated to protect him. Together the girls rescue the real politico in time for his all-important address. programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E1
programme.desc: Captain Tony Nelson, an astronaut, is engaged to Melissa Stone, daughter of General Wingard Stone, his commanding officer. Tony is rocketed into space in a capsule which lands is the Pacific. He reaches a small island. There he releases Jeannie, a beautiful blonde, who can perform magic with a blink of her eyes, from a bottle is which she has been imprisoned for ages. Jeannie tells Tony she is his slave forever. Worried about Jeannie's effect on Melissa and his career, Tony tries to leave Jeannie behind on the island, but she smuggles herself aboard the rescue plan. Questioned about his reactions in space by the base psychiatrist, Dr. Alfred Bellows, Tony tells about his meeting with Jeannie. Feeling that Tony is suffering from hallucinations, Bellows calls General Stone.Jeannie appears at Tony's home. Tony tries frantically to keep General Stone, Melissa, Doctor Bellows and Captain Roger Henley, a fellow astronaut, from seeing Jeannie. His problems reach a climax when Jeannie produces a harem of dancing girls to perform for Tony. After Tony works his way out of that, Melissa and her father leave, feeling a vacation, combined with a honeymoon, will solve Tony's problems. Tony orders Jeannie to leave no doubt that she is determined to be a part of Tony's life for a long time.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E3
programme.sub-title: Guess What Happened On The Way To The Moon
programme.desc: To test man's ability to survive on the moon, Captain Anthony (Tony) Nelson, and his fellow astronaut, Captain Roger Healey, are ordered to spend a week, in Furnace Canyon, Nevada, 100 degrees in the daytime, 10 below freezing at night. Except for water, they are to live off the land. Jeannie hides in Tony's canteen. Tony tries to make Jeannie understand that she is destroying the value of the mission, but she sticks with him. While Roger barely survives, Tony has every luxury, from food and a harem tent, to a final ride on a camel to finish the journey.Dr. Bellows is baffled to find that while Roger has lost twelve pounds, Tony has gained five. When Tony tries to explain Jeannie's presence, Dr. Bellows concludes that he has the imagina-tion men need to survive on the moon and recommends Tony for a more arduous test, Operation Extinction. Tony tells Jeannie he is taking her with him, but imprisons her within her bottle, de-termined to go on the mission alone.

programme.title: I Dream Of Jeannie (Colorized) S1E4
programme.desc: Although the date hasn't been set, Tony forbids Jeannie from accompanying Melissa and himself on their honeymoon. Grover Caldwell, a young State Department attaché, tells Tony that General Stone, Melissa's father, has accepted an ambassadorial post. General Stone announces he hopes to take Tony, his prospective son-in-law, along as his military aide. When Tony expresses his desire to remain with the space program, Melissa, who has been working to advance the marriage date, tells her father she will change Tony's mind. She suggests that Grover replace Roger as Tony's best man.Jeannie, determined to accompany Tony, prepares an oriental feast when Melissa and her father dine at Tony's. Before serving, Jeannie turns herself into a Filipino houseboy. Melissa suggests they take the houseboy to Europe with them. Tony is given a bachelor dinner in which Jeannie emerges dancing from a prop cake. Jeannie learns that Grover is an old boy friend of Melissa's. Before Jeannie is through, Grover tells Melissa he loves her. Tony is not completely unhappy to be left with Jeannie, when Grover and Melissa declare their intentions to marry.

programme.desc: Jodha Akbar is a period drama set in the sixteenth century, focusing on the political marriage between Mughal Emperor Akbar and Rajput Princess Jodha Bai. Initially a marriage of convenience, it evolves into a deep love story that changes the fate of India. The series portrays the era's wars, the complex relationships between the Mughals and Rajputs, and the political dynamics of the royal court. Akbar, raised as a ruthless conqueror, learns the meaning of love and compassion through Jodha, who despises the Mughals for their invasions. Their relationship transforms Akbar from a heartless ruler into the beloved Emperor Akbar, known for his justice and wisdom.

programme.title: North America's National Parks
programme.desc: Yellowstone National Park is an American national park located in the western United States, largely in the northwest corner of Wyoming and extending into Montana, and Idaho. It was established by the U.S. Congress and signed into law by President Ulysses S. Grant on March 1, 1872. Yellowstone was the first national park in the U.S. and is also widely held to be the first national park in the world. The park is known for its wildlife and its many geothermal features, especially Old Faithful geyser, one of its most popular. While it represents many types of biomes, the subalpine forest is the most abundant. It is part of the South Central Rockies forests ecoregion.

programme.desc: On the island, Lloyd learns that his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen and when the Ninja meet the playfully deceitful ruler, they realize they are in a tournament where “Only one can remain.” On the island, Lloyd learns his father used to train under the deceitful Master Chen. They meet the playfully deceitful ruler who tells them they are in a tournament where ‘Only one can remain'. When they are spoiled by their posh quarters, they are surprised to find the game is already afoot: Last person to find a Jade Blade is out. After an epic battle of elemental powers, Kai steals the last one from Karlof, who is kicked out of the tournament through a trap door leading to the unknown. Later that night, the Ninja go in search for Zane but come across an underground temple where Chen and his Anacondrai Worshippers steal Karlof's power. Is this a fighting tournament, or a ploy to steal everyone's power?

programme.title: Versus
programme.desc: In order find Zane, the Ninja stay in the tournament to get past the first round but Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. In order to find Zane and get to the bottom of Chen's mysterious plot the Ninja need to stay in the tournament and get past the first round. Chen complicates things by changing the bracket and pitting Jay against Cole. Meanwhile, new Titanium Ninja Zane is locked in a dungeon and has a nightmare about a ferocious Ice Dragon. Guided by the voice of Pixal, he embraces his new technology and escapes his cell, only to find Pixal hasn't fared as well. Though she has no body, he inputs her CPU into his, uniting the two. In an attempt to prevent Jay versus Cole, the Ninja enlist the Master of Mind to help, but are unable to prevent the inevitable. In a gladiator battle, Jay and Cole put aside their feud to throw the match --enraging Chen to send Cole down the mysterious trap door. Lastly, Nya sees Zane's beacon is working again and is on the hunt for them.

programme.title: Winds Of Change
programme.desc: Kai promises to watch over Lloyd when Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain– but when Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only to discover it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. After the Ninja save a small fishing village, Lloyd fears the loss of his father will make the path ahead uncertain but Kai promises to watch over him. When Wu sends them out on an errand for his new Tea Farm, Lloyd goes on a solo mission... only it's a trap from a GHOST who's escaped the Cursed Realm. When the Ninja's powers mysteriously disappear, they return to the Tea Farm and are attacked by Lloyd, who is possessed by the spirit of Moro, the Master of Wind! After a harrowing escape on the Bounty, Wu tells the Ninja they weren't his first pupils!

programme.title: Ghost Story
programme.desc: When Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja – and the Ninja discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. Moro gives chase to the Bounty and steals Wu's staff, leaving them to crash. When the dust settles, Wu shares the story of Moro: the boy who wanted to be the Green Ninja. They discover Wu's staff contained 3 symbols that lead to the Tomb of the First Spinjitzu Master which holds a mysterious relic that could alter the course of Ninjago. In order to save Lloyd and get their powers back, they set off to find the first clue – the scroll to the lost martial art of ‘Airjitzu'. On their way to get it, they have a run in with one of Moro's ghost generals Wraythe, and discover water is the key to stopping them. Meanwhile, Nya discovers a family secret – her mother was a Water Ninja and with training, she could be one too.

programme.title: Saturday Knight Fever
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters catching a cold means trouble for the NEXO-Knights when he can create an entirely new kind of “snotty” monster. King and Queen Halbert have journeyed to the town of Cleanington to open the brand new Scrubbery Barn at the invitation of Roger the Scrubber (seen in 104.) Meanwhile, the Book of Monsters drags Jestro to Snottingham – one of the coldest places in Knighton where everyone coughs, has a runny nose and is generally under-the-weather. The BOM demands that Jestro feed him a “snotheiser” ball which will probably make him sick. The BOM explains that if he is sick, he may just produce a whole new breed of magical monsters … some that the knights would NEVER expect. The BOM gets sick and starts coughing up phlegm globlins and bloblins. The Knights arrive, alerted to what they think is an attack on the town by Snottingham's mayor, Hack Coughmeier. The sickened, sneezy, snotty monsters infect the knights and, more importantly, the knights' NEXO-Shields. Now their NEXO-Powers are infected. As they try to download something to fight the monsters, they realize the powers they get are off strange, infected versions of their powers. The knights drive Jestro and his snot monsters off and they turn in for the night. And, overnight, they all get sick. Meanwhile, the BOM order a nice, hot lava bath…he'll feel fine by morning. But the knights wake-up with colds and they feel terrible. Ava and Merlok 2.0 thinks it will pass in a day or two…it's just a typical Snottingham cold. Each knight gets sick in their own funny way and their illnesses play right into Jestro and the BOM's hands: they're headed to Cleanington to kidnap the king! The citizens of the ultra-clean city hate the sight of monsters, but then feel caught in between when the sick, sneezy, snotty knights arrive on their Fortrex. The fight goes terribly for the knights. They try to download the Nexo-power “Glorious Griffon” but instead get just feathers. So they improvise and tickle the monsters! Ava finally comes up with a way to use some anti-virus tools on their NEXO-Shields and just as Jestro is about to take the king and queen away, the NEXO-Knights get their normal powers back! They defeat Jestro and save the king and queen.

programme.title: Open Mike Knight
programme.desc: The Book of Betrayal leads Jestro and his Monsters to Funnyton – the funnies town in the kingdom. When they Knights arrive to capture him, they discover (to their shock) that Jestro and the Book of Monsters are now the town's top comedians! Jestro and his monsters are in attack formation moving to pillage the town of Funnyton. But when they arrive, ready to tear into the place, they see that nobody's in town. Then, they hear…laughter?! The entire town is there listening to a stand-up comic JOKES KNIGHTLY. He's hilarious. He commands such power, such attention, and such loyalty. Jestro and the BOM decide they must become funny. They order all kinds of book on comedy from Spamazon: books on parody, irony, insult humor, slapstick, satire, knock-knock jokes, elephant jokes, “my monster is so fat” jokes, etc. They work-up a ventriloquist act with the BOM sitting on Jestro's lap. They start doing their act and, surprisingly, they're funny. They're very funny. The Fortrex arrives and the knights rush out, ready for battle. They fight through a string of monsters just outside the town, but discover they're only working as “bouncers” to keep too many people out of the comedy club. (“Sorry, you guys aren't on the list.”) The knights hear loud laughs and head there. In the club, they discover the town isn't being held hostage, they're in the show voluntarily having a great time. And…Jestro and the BOM are funny. Meanwhile, during the show, Jokes Knightly decides he'll steal the BOM and Jestro's act. During the intermission at the comedy show, Clay comes backstage to talk to Jestro. Maybe, Clay says, this shows that Jestro doesn't have to be bad…he is funny, like Clay always said he was. Meanwhile, Jokes Knightly steals the BOM and Jestro can't find it. He panics. Clay encourages him…go on stage alone, be funny…he can do it! Jestro goes out and is funny on his own he hits all his punchlines, he gets big laughs he starts to see that Clay is right. The BOM sees that Jokes Knightly has a “joke book” that turns out to be the BOOK OF BETRAYAL. That's how Mike Knight has become so funny – by stealing everyone's material! BOM calls in Magmar, who saves him from Mike Knight AND takes the Book of Betrayal. As Jestro comes off-stage to great applause, the BOM tells him they have the Book of Betrayal. The BOM calls in Magmar and his monsters and they start a fight as Clay comes to Jestro's defense and calls on the other Knights for backup. A big battle ensues that destroys the comedy club in Funnyton. The Knights win and drive-off Magmar, the monsters and the BOM. As they retreat, the BOM looks around: “Where's my Jestro?!” Jestro sneaked away during the fight and is in a nearby forest with…the Book of Betrayal.

programme.title: The Fortrex And The Furious
programme.desc: In a massive chase around Knighton, the NEXO-Knights attempt to keep the Book of Betrayal out of the Book of Monster's grip. But the evil book is persistent. Will he get the final piece of his evil puzzle? We finally REVEAL that Jestro has given the Book of Betrayal to…Clay. He tells Clay what it is and how Mike Knight used it. And it seems that the Book of Monsters believed it to be the final ingredient in some ‘Master Plan.” Suddenly, they realize Monsters – led by Magmar and the super-mad Book of Monster – are after them! Clay retreats with Jestro and the Book of Betrayal to rendezvous with the other Knights at the Fortrex. The Fortrex isn't fast enough they'll need their own vehicles. They decide that they need to split up and go in multiple directions to make the monsters expend their resources on a chase. It's a huge chase, being covered like a crazy news event by the Knighton News Network. We see a montage of the monsters stopping and capturing all the Knights vehicles: Aaron, Macy, Lance…finally Axl. However, as they do, they realize that the Knights have used Squirebots in Jestro Fan Jester hats (from the vendor at the comedy club in 108) as decoys. They think Axl has the Book of Betrayal in his BRICK containment unit, but it turns out to be the Ned Knightly Comic from episode 203. The Monsters finally corner Clay, who has the real Jestro and Book of Betrayal in his sword vehicle. Before Clay can protest, Jestro pushes the launch button and fires off Clay in the vehicle's rocket sword. The monsters race off with Jestro, leaving the shocked Clay fearing for his friend. Now, Magmar tells the Book of Monsters, they only need to get BOB. Clay makes his way back to the Fortrex and tells what has happened. They decide they must get to the Redoubt of Ruination in the Lava Lands and try to save Jestro. Meanwhile, we see, INTERCUT, a scene where Merlok 2.0 and the Book of Monsters explain the Books of Evil, how they were created and what the BOM will use them for. Merlok, back in the day, split the evil MONSTRUX into 10 magic books to keep him from ever being a threat. Only, he didn't destroy the books…and now the BOM has them and Monstrux can come back into the world! Meanwhile, the BOM has set up the huge, ceremonial arena at their HQ so they can have the ceremony to bring Monstrux back into the world. Jestro realizes he's been a pawn of the Book of Monsters. Jestro says he'll never get the Book of Betrayal…the Knights have it. In the last scene, we see Clay taking the Book of Betrayal from the Fortrex, climbing into his vehicle and driving towards…the Redoubt of Ruination! Has the Book of Betrayal worked its evil magic on him?!

programme.title: Kingdom Of Heroes
programme.desc: The Book of Monsters, having the final pieces of his evil plan in place, tries to take human form. Can the NEXO-Knights and Merlok 2.0 stop the greatest threat they've ever faced? Or will the kingdom be plunged into darkness…forever. The Redoubt of Ruination readies the final ceremony to call forth MONSTRUX, the arch-necromancer of the past. Clay, holding the Book of Betrayal walks to the gates of the spooky place. Inside, Clay hears strange…singing and music. It's like a twisted Broadway show of some kind. Meanwhile, the Knights all realize Clay is gone and so is the Book of Betrayal. Macy says Clay must be up to something. They have to trust him and, more importantly, they have to find him. At the Redoubt of Ruination the ceremony has already begun! The Book of Monsters wants the final ceremony that calls forth Monstrux to be like a really great show! The BOM then barfs up all the BOOKS OF EVIL into their places around Jestro. He's just missing the BOOK OF BETRAYAL, which Clay has. Clay says he'll trade the book for Jestro. The BOM immediately agrees to the deal and sets Jestro free. Then, Monsters grab-up Clay, restrain him, and put him in Jestro's place on the sacrifice stone. From outside, they're interrupted by the sounds of battle the Knights have arrived on the Fortrex and are attacking the Redoubt of Ruination. In the confusion, Jestro slips away. The BOM lets loose with a powerful protection spell to keep the Knights out as he starts with the ceremony…he's going to bring Monstrux out and remanifest him in Clay's body! Jestro is able to escape the Redoubt and make his way to the Knights, who can't seem to battle their way in. It's a race against time as the Knights try to get in and save Clay. As the Knights get in, they see that the crazy BOM is absorbing all the Books of Evil, one-by-one. He grows BIGGER and BIGGER! Macy calls for NEXO-Power…but it's not enough! The gigantic Book of Monsters sucks down the final book, the Book of Betrayal! He looms over Clay, about to consume him, too, and make him into Monstrux! Suddenly, Robin appears carrying TECHKALIBER…he tosses it to Clay. Just as the huge Book of Monsters falls on Clay, he holds up Techkaliber and Merlok 2.0 is there…his full power in the sword. Clay sticks the sword into the Book of Monster's huge mouth. BOOM! There's a BIG, MAGICAL EXPLOSION! As we cut back inside, we see the Book of Monsters is gone. The Knights release Clay and he thanks them and Jestro for saving him. Jestro thanks them all for saving him and seeing the good in him. WE DISSOLVE TO: The JoustDome. In a final ceremony the King and Queen reward the knights and congratulate them for keeping the kingdom safe. There are speeches, happiness and friendship. And Jestro even does a bit that's funny. At the very end we see a hint of something…Monstrux and the Book of Monsters are still out there.

programme.desc: Handwriting Analysis- We've all heard that our handwriting tells more about our personalities than we think. Are we risk-takers, have low-esteem, fun loving, or are we capable of murder? While our handwriting may not reveal the nuances of our personalities, the dotting of the 'i's and crossing of the 't's is an important business in criminal investigation. Apparent suicide notes, letters from suspected offenders and signatures are scrutinized down to the last dot. Handwriting comparisons can tell if the victim really did sign that new life insurance policy, or if the person who had everything to live for actually wrote the eloquent suicide note.

programme.title: Diagnosis: Unknown: Death Shift

In fact, death seemed to follow Donald Harvey from job to job, beginning in 1970 and ending with his arrest in 1987. Harvey – probably the most prolific serial murderer in the nation's history – claimed to have murdered his ailing charges out of compassion, but his meticulous diary, 30 pounds of cyanide, and a witch's brew of dangerous drugs discovered in his home pointed to darker motives. And his quiet rampage would have likely continued, if not for the vigilant coroner who decided to investigate further the odd smell of almonds coming from his fresh corpse.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: DAHEJ DAASI
programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. However, she becomes entangled in the chains of deceit, finding herself on the path to becoming a Dahej Dasi, which is a tradition still prevalent in the backward regions of Rajasthan. The show unfolds into a compelling drama of tradition versus rebellion, love versus oppression.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.6
programme.desc: Do Hyun can't stop thinking about Ri Jin, which only fuels Se Gi's jealousy. Eventually, Se Gi warns him, “If you touch my woman, yours will be in danger.” Provoked, Do Hyun goes to Ri Jin and asks her to become his secret personal doctor.

programme.title: Kill me, Heal me Ep.7
programme.desc: Tae Im questions Director Ahn about the reason for Do Hyun's return to Korea, leaving him flustered. Ri Jin struggles to stop Yo Seob from taking his own life. programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.title: New 2023 Range Rover Sport Design Reveal Film
programme.desc: The New Range Rover Sport has made its global premiere with a dramatic world-first climb up a flooded dam spillway in Iceland. The epic ascent saw New Range Rover Sport resist the surging torrent of water flowing down the ramp of the Karahnjukar Dam – the biggest of its kind in the world – at a rate of 750 tonnes per minute. A loss of traction risked plunging down the perilous 90m drop at the base of the spillway to the valley floor below. The successful spillway ascent was screened for the first time at an exclusive launch event at Jaguar Land Rover's Advanced Product Creation Centre at Gaydon, UK. Official James Bond stunt driver Jessica Hawkins was behind the wheel as the New Range Rover Sport demonstrated its grip, traction, performance and composure, completing the latest in a series of challenges for Land Rover's luxury performance SUV. Previous feats include a record-setting hill-climb at Pikes Peak, a first recorded crossing of the ‘Empty Quarter' desert in the Arabian Peninsula and a first ascent of the 999 steps to Heaven's Gate in China, in 2018.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings.
